feeds.title: UN Geneva
feeds.description: UN Geneva is working for Peace, Rights, and Well-being. In the historic setting of the Palais des Nations, UN Geneva brings together individuals, organizations and nations to ensure a better future for all. As a diplomatic center, with near universal representation of states, Geneva is the ideal location for successful international cooperation.

feeds.title: UN Peacekeeping
feeds.description: UN Peacekeeping helps countries navigate the difficult path from conflict to peace. We have unique strengths, including legitimacy, burden sharing, and an ability to deploy troops and police from around the world, integrating them with civilian peacekeepers to address a range of mandates set by the UN Security Council and General Assembly.

feeds.title: United Nations Population Fund
feeds.description: UNFPA is the United Nations sexual and reproductive health agency. Our mission is to deliver a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.

feeds.title: UN Land and Drought
feeds.description: Learn how the land is impacted by different aspects and how we can combat it and have healthy, productive and accessible land for all. The UNCCD is the global voice for land. We promote practices that avoid, reduce and reverse land degradation and are the driving force behind Sustainable Development Goal 15 and Land Degradation Neutrality.

feeds.title: UNMAS
feeds.description: The UNMAS leads, coordinates, and implements projects and programmes to mitigate the threats posed by explosive ordnance to the benefit of millions of people worldwide. Our vision is a world free of mines and ERW, where individuals and communities live in a safe environment conducive to development and where the needs of the survivors and victims are met as well as getting integrated into the society.

feeds.title: Inner City Press
feeds.description: The Inner City Press is an investigative reporting from the inner city to Wall Street to the United Nations. Matthew Russell Lee has been reporting for Inner City Press since 2007.

feeds.title: UN News
feeds.description: UN News produces daily news content in Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Kiswahili, Portuguese, Russian and Spanish, and weekly programmes in Hindi, Urdu and Bangla. The United Nations is one place where the world's nations can gather together, discuss common problems and find shared solutions.

feeds.title: UN Women
feeds.description: UN Women is the global champion for gender equality, working to develop and uphold standards and create an environment in which every woman and girl can exercise her human rights and live up to her full potential. We are trusted partners for advocates and decision-makers from all walks of life, and a leader in the effort to achieve gender equality.

feeds.title: PassBlue
feeds.description: The PassBlue is an Independent Coverage of the United Nations. We are a women-led nonprofit multimedia news company that closely covers the US-UN relationship, women's issues, human rights, peacekeeping and other urgent global matters playing out in the world body.

feeds.title: United Nations Press
feeds.description: The UN Press covers all the press releases, press conferences, statements, meetings, and more for the United Nations. The United Nations is an international organization founded in 1945. It is the one place on Earth where all the world's nations can gather together, discuss common problems, and find shared solutions that benefit all of humanity.

feeds.title: UN Environment Programme
feeds.description: The global authority for the environment with programmes focusing on climate, nature, pollution, sustainable development and more. UNEP's mission is to provide leadership and encourage partnership in caring for the environment by inspiring, informing, and enabling nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations.

feeds.title: UN Dispatch
feeds.description: UN Dispatch is a site providing commentary and coverage on the UN and UN-related issues. The intended purpose is to offer thoughtful perspective on the UN and UN-related issues, provide factual information about the UN's work, and fact-check claims and coverage about the UN offered by pundits, journalists, bloggers and others.

feeds.title: The Global Humanitarian
feeds.description: Covers articles for those looking to enter the humanitarian aid and development field. Created by an aid worker for aid workers.

feeds.title: United Nations Police
feeds.description: United Nations Police are deployed in most peacekeeping operations and are deployed as advisers in a number of United Nations Special Political Missions. The mission of UN Police is to enhance international peace and security by supporting Member-States in conflict, post-conflict and other crisis situations.

feeds.title: UN Public Administration Network
feeds.description: UNPAN is a global network that connects relevant international, regional, subregional and national institutions and experts worldwide working on effective governance and public administration for sustainable development in line with Goal 16 of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

feeds.title: United Nations ESCAP
feeds.description: ESCAP serves as the United Nations' regional hub promoting cooperation among countries to achieve inclusive and sustainable development. It is the largest regional intergovernmental platform with 53 Member States and 9 associate members.

feeds.title: UNRWA
feeds.description: The United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA) is a relief and human development agency. UNRWA is funded almost entirely by voluntary contributions from UN Member States. We provide assistance and protection for some 5 million registered Palestine refugees to help them achieve their full potential in human development.

feeds.title: United Nations Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Read about ideas, and resources connecting people with the United Nations to solve global problems. The UN Foundation, a public charity, was created in 1998 with entrepreneur and philanthropist Ted Turner's historic $1 billion gifts to support UN causes.

feeds.title: UN Humanitarian
feeds.description: The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) helps humanitarian organizations save the lives of people caught in crises. With its partners, OCHA contributes to principled and effective humanitarian response through coordination, advocacy, policy, information management and humanitarian financing tools and services.

feeds.title: United Nations Development Programme
feeds.description: UNDP's sustainable development blog is written by experts working in over 170 countries and territories. They are helping to eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities and exclusion, and build resilience so countries can sustain progress. We advocate for change, and connect countries to knowledge, experience and resources to help people build a better life.

feeds.title: UN Climate Change
feeds.description: The United Nation's Climate Change blog informs you about the most recent effects of Climate Change and the actions taken by the UN to counter it. The UNFCCC secretariat is part of the United Nations. Created in 1945 and guided by its founding Charter, the UN takes action on the most critical issues confronting humanity in the 21st century.

feeds.title: UNCTADstat
feeds.description: UNCTADstat gives access to more than 150 indicators and statistical time series for almost all economies of the world. All statistics of UNCTAD are harmonized and integrated into UNCTADstat- free to use dissemination platform. It gives access to basic and derived indicators built upon common rules, harmonized environment and clear methodology supported by powerful data browsing system.

feeds.title: UN Careers
feeds.description: Find out about the available career opportunities and meet the Global Workforce in the UN. The United Nations is an international organization founded in 1945 and committed to maintaining international peace and security; developing friendly relations among nations; promoting social progress, better living standards and human rights.

feeds.title: UN Political and Peacebuilding
feeds.description: The Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs (DPPA) plays a central role in United Nations efforts to prevent and resolve deadly conflict around the world. DPPA monitors and assesses global political developments with an eye to detecting potential crises and devising effective responses.

feeds.title: UN University
feeds.description: UNU contributes, through research and education, to efforts to resolve pressing global problems of human survival, development and welfare. The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organisation headquartered in Japan.

feeds.title: UN Job List
feeds.description: United Nations vacancies compiled by Sebastian Rottmair. Search the comprehensive job database for job title, duty station, UN organisation or job level. Sign-up for weekly e-mail alerts or use the extensive RSS features to get the vacancies you want to get.

feeds.title: UNESCO
feeds.description: UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. It seeks to build peace through international cooperation in education, sciences and culture.

feeds.title: UN Human Rights
feeds.description: The Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (UN Human Rights) is the leading UN entity on human rights. We represent the world's commitment to the promotion and protection of the full range of human rights and freedoms set out in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

feeds.title: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
feeds.description: UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency, is a global organisation dedicated to saving lives, protecting rights and building a better future for refugees, forcibly displaced communities and stateless people. They work to ensure that everybody has the right to seek asylum and find safe refuge, having fled violence, persecution, war or disaster at home.

feeds.title: UNPOG
feeds.description: The United Nations Project Office on Governance is part of the Division for Public Institutions and Digital Government of the United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs. Its principal mission is to strengthen the public governance capacities of developing Member States in Asia and the Pacific and beyond to achieve the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
